name: intelligent-delegate
description: Routes a task to the right execution shape — inline, a single subagent, or a Workflow fan-out — and picks the model tier and reasoning effort to match, for speed, result quality and cost together, including what the orchestrator's own context costs. Ships eight pre-tiered agent definitions, each pinning a model, an effort, a turn budget and a tool surface, because a subagent that names none inherits the session's; a PreToolUse hook that blocks a Workflow whose agent() calls carry no agentType; and an audit script that splits a session's spend into orchestrator and subagents. Tier defaults are set from a measured model x effort sweep.
